mgmt_bio.text: Yuen Kuan Moon has been Group Chief Executive Officer of Singapore Telecommunications Limited (Singtel) since 1 January 2021, succeeding Chua Sock Koong after a global search covering internal and external candidates. He joined Singtel in 1993 and held leadership roles in marketing, business development and sales, and in 2003 was posted to Telkomsel as General Manager for Product Development, then Director of Commerce from 2005 to 2007. He was CEO, Consumer Singapore from June 2012, and Group Chief Digital Officer from August 2018 to December 2020. He holds first-class honours in engineering from the University of Western Australia and a Master of Science in Management from Stanford University.
